summary: Brief 6 final check passed; the full record (gates, smoke checks, scans, screenshots, known issues and the plain-words user summary) is docs/redesign/reports/final-verification-6.json. Brief 6 (rename to Disaster Mapping, flood time steps, a clearer 3D flood view, zoom dimming off by default) passed its final check. The working tree was clean at 3265d56. All gates are green: backend 1466 passed, 0 skipped; web typecheck ok, lint 55 warnings all in src/scene, 151 test files with 1917 passed and 2 skipped (two real-fire data tests, not floods), build ok. No app code changed in this step, so these runs stand for the final commit. 27 final screenshots were taken and viewed. A scratch Playwright smoke run passed 134 of 134 checks across 18 views: no old name seen or heard, the name in the bar and the page title, both fixed safety lines on every view, no banned safety word outside official verbatim text, no console error; Play, Pause, the step buttons and the Space, comma and full stop keys; no autoplay; under reduced motion one step per press; zoom dimming off by default, switched on in Layers & settings and remembered. The top-bar overlap check passed 24 of 24 pages. Count-only scans: FIRMS_MAP_KEY 0 in 1998 tracked files, 0 in the diffs and messages of the 37 commits from 8ae4614 to f37a592; EARTHDATA_TOKEN not set here; 0 assignments of either name to a long value; 'FireTrace' 0 in code and UI; 'safe' and 'low risk' 0 in UI copy. The README's flood Command and Forensic paragraphs, Keyboard line, words table, known limits and pictures now describe brief 6 as built; its demo-flood commands now run scripts/flood_3d.py fixture-flood, which the demo needs for its time steps and 3D products.

known_issues: Real flat floods still look fairly flat in 3D. St. Johns River and Calcasieu River open at ×10 and the key says 'Still flat at ×10: raise it, or use River view.' (×15 and ×20 are offered). The demo flood shows the effect clearly; real floods only modestly.

On real floods the grey 'no satellite view' hatching covers much of the 3D view (St. Johns River passes are 53 to 97 % hidden by clouds or missing data), and the depth tint shows only where a pass saw water: small patches at Calcasieu, little at St. Johns.
Height above the river tints almost all land on flat coastal plains (Calcasieu, St. Johns), so it adds little there. It is off by default and labelled 'Not a flood map'.

Depth estimates are rough: a little low near gentle banks, a metre or more off where banks are steep or the water map and terrain do not line up, and near 0 m in the river's normal channel. Depth exists only for the bundle's shown pass, each kept pass and the NWS forecast area; a pass shown only as its picture has no depth surface (the key says so).

At a past step the NWS forecast flooded area, FEMA, NWS category maps and the model still show now (tagged 'now'), and 'Official now' lists what is in effect now; the step's own NWS versions are in the 'NWS · n' list and on the map.

At now the map draws the pass the satellite layer picked (shown_key), which can be older than the newest usable pass (St. Johns: Oct 26 shown, Oct 29 listed). The 3D key says 'Newer satellite passes exist'; the 2D legend does not. A later brief could let shown_key prefer the newest usable pass.

NASA lists a satellite pass 2 to 4 days after it was taken, so the newest days of a live flood often have no step yet ('No satellite image after Oct 29 yet'). The radar route (DSWx-S1, EARTHDATA_TOKEN) is tested offline only; no token was set here.

Entering Public puts the time handle back at now, so a step chosen in Command is lost after a trip through Public (Forensic keeps it). Play stops at the latest step; Next or the chart's NOW returns to now.

Forensic's credits outside the dock do not add the Iowa Environmental Mesonet archive line while its 3D warning lines draw archived NWS versions; the dock's NWS column and the 'NWS · n' list carry the tag, link and credit.

Fire and flood Forensic were checked only in SwiftShader (no GPU in the cloud): the terrain shader's fire and flood variants link with 13 and 14 texture units. Please run both on a real Mac GPU (node scripts/shot.mjs … --backend gpu) at low and high quality.
make_fixture.py --only flood still writes the demo flood without its four simulated passes and 3D products; the README now tells you to run scripts/flood_3d.py fixture-flood after it.

Flood bundles prepared before the rename keep 'Fire-3d' in saved notes until prepared again or until scripts/flood_3d.py rewrites them (README Known limits gives the commands); this container's bundles are clean. backend/fire3d/data/gazetteer_us.json keeps the old name in a source note the app never shows.
The page title of the demo flood reads 'Ridge Fork River flood · live · Disaster Mapping' and its Forensic header shows LIVE next to DEMO (brief-5 behaviour, not changed here).
Bundles with the time history and 3D products are larger (St. Johns River about 38 MB on disk).
